correctness.rationale: Prime dividing cyclotomic resultant iff some order-eleven root yields a short zero sum, since Phi_11 splits squarefree modulo p≡1 mod11. Affine transformations exhaustively reduce 286 three-term and 1001 four-term multisets to 4 and 12 classes with exact ten-by-ten integral determinant norms. The full norm factorization yields exactly two primes for length three and six for length four. No length one or two occurs by subgroup order; the minimum-four set excludes the already minimum-three primes. Standalone pure-Python verifier passed.
